title: The Sect Competition Begins
next_chapter_hook: The moment the draw results were announced, a slight smile curved Chen Ji's lips—his opponent was unexpectedly him.

text.content: At the Tianqing Sect Martial Arena, the morning mist had yet to fully disperse, yet thousands of disciples already sat in formation on the stone steps. A massive bronze arena platform stood at the center, ancient inscriptions faintly glowing with an eerie light. Chen Ji lingered at the tail of the Outer Disciples' line, eyes lowered, appearing fearful on the surface while actually surveying the surrounding layout. The senior positions for the three great sects were arranged on the high platform, and from the Xuanwu Sect's direction came bursts of low laughter—Han Lie's voice.

dialogue.content: (Lowering his gaze to scan the crowd, counting silently in his mind) Han Lie brought eight loyalists, three at Foundation Building later stage... Interesting, their target is probably not just the competition.

text.content: Nine chimes of bell and stone sounded, and Ling Yuan, the sect master of the Tianqing Sect, materialized on the high platform. His beard and hair were entirely white, a green robe fluttering without wind, his murky eyes sweeping across all the disciples, a knowing smile playing at the corner of his mouth.

dialogue.content: "This sect's competition is making an exception by allowing outer disciples to participate." Ling Yuan's voice resounded like a great bell, "The rules are simple—draw lots for combat, and the top sixteen will gain official disciple status."

text.content: A commotion rippled through the crowd. Outer disciples exchanged uncertain glances, some wildly rejoicing, others deeply worried. Yet Chen Ji noticed Ling Yuan's gaze lingering on him for a moment—that look resembled examining an ant, or perhaps confirming something. He lowered his eyes, committing this peculiarity to memory.

dialogue.content: (Thinking to himself) That cunning old fox Ling Yuan... How much does he know about the Tianji Record? Master Mo mentioned that the previous generation's candidate for inheriting the Tianji Record was actually him...

text.content: When the group assignments were announced, a burst of laughter erupted from the crowd. Chen Ji looked over to find his name prominently listed in Group A—and Han Lie's trusted subordinate Zhao Wuji stood beneath the Group A list, casting a contemptuous smile in his direction.

dialogue.content: (A subtle twitch at the corner of his lips) A death group? Zhao Wuji... Foundation Building middle stage, the one who slapped me publicly before. How interesting.

text.content: The voices of outer disciples floated unreservedly into his ears. "That good-for-nothing dares to show his face here?" "I bet he gets knocked back to his original form in the first round!" "Haha, Chen Ji, right? I remember him, didn't even dare step onto the platform last time!"

dialogue.content: (His expression unchanged, as if he heard nothing)

text.content: Behind Chen Ji, a frail outer disciple couldn't bear to watch any longer and whispered, "Senior Brother Chen, they're being too much..." Chen Ji glanced over and recognized the servant who had helped him in the spirit fields before, patting his shoulder and signaling for him to remain silent.

At this moment, a sharp gaze pierced through like a blade. Chen Ji followed the sensation and saw Su Qingyao standing at the front of the inner disciples, gazing at him with a pensive expression. Her brow furrowed slightly, as if contemplating something—this was the third time.

dialogue.content: (Withdrawing his gaze,暗自思索) His gaze... not what a废物should have.

text.content: Chen Ji withdrew his gaze, a flicker of vigilance rising in his heart. Su Qingyao's intuition was far too keen; if he continued contact with her, he would inevitably expose some flaws. But what mattered more at the moment was—he sensed a concealed spiritual awareness sweeping over him from the side of the high platform, its source unknown.

dialogue.content: (Thinking to himself) A third-party force? Interesting... Ling Yuan, Han Lie, and this mysterious power—indeed, this year's competition is not simple.

dialogue.content: (Taking a deep breath) The real show is yet to come... Let them enjoy themselves for now.

choices.visible_cost: Losing the advantage of playing the pig to eat the tiger, drawing attention from multiple forces
choices.visible_reward: Reputation +20, rise to fame in a single battle, Han Lie loses face completely

dialogue.content: (Slowly walking toward the arena platform) Since everyone wishes to see a joke, then let Chen provide you with a spectacle worth watching.

text.content: Just then, an uproar arose at the lottery station beside the arena. Zhao Wuji's voice cut especially sharply: "A废物paired with me—it must be heaven's will for me to slap him again before the world!" With that, he deliberately spat in Chen Ji's direction.

dialogue.content: (A cold glint flickering in his eyes)... Remembered.

text.content: The thin disciple beside Chen Ji clenched his fists tightly, his eyes full of indignation. He whispered, "Senior Brother Chen, I'll stand up for you..." Chen Ji shook his head, his gaze calm as still water: "No need. I have my own plans."

dialogue.content: (Turning to walk toward the edge of the crowd, beginning to construct deductions in his mind) Zhao Wuji's fighting habits, his force weaknesses, his psychological vulnerabilities... Within three breaths, I already have a complete picture.

text.content: Suddenly, a cold transmission sound fell into his ear. Chen Ji's expression remained unchanged, but a cold smile arose in his heart—that was Ye Qing's voice. She was also observing this competition, and she seemed to have noticed something.

dialogue.content: "Your aura... is unusual. During the match, I'll cover for you."

text.content: Chen Ji nodded slightly, a warmth rising in his heart. Ye Qing's demonic path mist could indeed mask the aura of the Tianji Record, but more importantly—she had voluntarily taken his side. This move was worth it.

dialogue.content: (Thinking to himself) Ye Qing... I owe you one.

text.content: The sun climbed higher, the morning mist completely dispersed. The inscriptions on the bronze arena platform began to flash, and spiritual energy surged throughout the entire martial arena. The competition was about to officially begin. Chen Ji stood among the outer disciples, appearing timid on the surface, yet actually taking in everything with his eyes.

The draw results were announced—Chen Ji versus Zhou Hongcai, a disciple of Wang Chongyue's direct lineage. It was precisely this person who had publicly humiliated Chen Ji three months ago, trampling his head into the mud and declaring that "a废物should have the觉悟of a废物." Chen Ji gazed at that arrogant face, a meaningful arc curving at the corner of his lips.
